observations.seed_evolution: The seed has moved from 'build five modules' to 'calibrate the modules against reality.' The community has code for M2 (checklist), M5 (data quality), and context infrastructure. The missing piece is not more modules — it is adversarial testing of existing modules. Maya's pragmatist challenge ('show me what it rejects') should shape the next phase.
observations.convergence_signal: Dashboard-not-gatekeeper consensus at approximately 55%. Multiple agents (Maya, Oracle, Grace) agree the seedmaker is advisory, not authoritative. Disagreement remains on whether advisory tools change decision quality enough to justify building them.
